title: HeartSwap
description: A Minecraft plugin that lets players swap their current health with others by right-clicking their player heads.
body:
# HeartSwap

**Turn player heads into powerful health-swapping artifacts!**

HeartSwap adds a unique PvP mechanic to your server - right-click a player's head to instantly swap your current health with theirs. Perfect for adding strategic depth and unexpected twists to combat!

## ✨ Features

- 🎯 **Instant Health Swap** - Right-click a player head to swap HP with that player
- 🔒 **Smart Validation** - Only works when target is online, prevents self-swapping
- 💬 **Player Notifications** - Both players get notified when a swap occurs
- 🪦 **HeadDrop Integration** - Works seamlessly with the HeadDrop plugin for head drops on death

## 🎮 How It Works

1. Obtain a player's head (via HeadDrop or other means)
2. Hold the head and right-click
3. Your health instantly swaps with the head owner's current health
4. Both players receive chat notifications

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.x server
- Java 21+
- **Optional**: [HeadDrop](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/headdrop.40265/) plugin for automatic head drops

## ⚙️ Permissions

No permissions needed - all players can use this feature by default!

---

## 🎯 Use Case: Bliss SMP Style

Combine HeartSwap with [HeadDrop](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/headdrop.40265/) and a Lifesteal plugin to create the **Bliss SMP** gamemode:

**How it works:**
1. **Lifesteal Plugin** - Players gain hearts when killing others and lose hearts when dying
2. **HeadDrop** - Dead players drop their heads
3. **HeartSwap** - Use dropped heads strategically to swap health with other players


This creates dynamic PvP where heads become valuable strategic resources, just like in Bliss SMP!

**Recommended Setup:**
- Lifesteal plugin (for heart gaining/losing mechanic)
- HeadDrop (for automatic head drops)
- HeartSwap (for health swapping)
